购物方式与不必要消费

本单元选用真实 Part 1 问题组中的两问。先分别口头作答，再比较参考写法如何回应问题；示例经历由本地编写，不是官方考生作答或统一标准答案。

When you go shopping, do you usually pay for things by cash or by card?
Have you ever spent money on something you didn't need?
参考作答

I usually pay by card because I don't like carrying a lot of cash. It's also easier to check what I've spent afterwards. I still keep a little cash with me in case a shop's card machine isn't working.

Yes, I once bought a pair of trainers mainly because they were on sale. I already had a similar pair, so I hardly wore the new ones. It wasn't a disaster, but it did make me stop and think before buying something just because the price looks attractive.

逐项解释与练习

两题分开回答：usually 对应现在的习惯与一个例外；Have you ever 对应 yes 后的一次经历，主要叙述用过去时。sale 不等于 need，结尾明确反思怎样从经历产生。

练习：保留题目中的对象、时间和问法，换成自己的真实经历。先口头作答，再对照上面的具体内容逐项检查；不需要逐字背诵参考作答。
